en.title: Why Cashing Out Cheesecake Factory at $120 Makes Sense

Reallocating capital before momentum fades protects multi-year gains. Follow for tomorrow.

en.title: Nvidia Net Margins at 60%: Are They Sustainable?

As capital expenditures tighten, margin compression becomes an unavoidable statistical reality.
Peak profitability leaves zero safety margin if infrastructure spending slows. Follow for tomorrow.
